assessment: Guiana/Guyana identity requires an explicit nomenclature convention before independent route estimation. No alias merge or fixed physical boundary admitted.

sources.evidence: Named Guyana continuation of non-retroflected NBC with seasonal NEC contribution; regional naming convention rather than universal boundary.

sources.citation: Baklouti et al. (2007), New insights in the French Guiana continental shelf circulation and its relation to the North Brazil Current retroflection, JGR Oceans 112, doi:10.1029/2006JC003520
sources.locator: Abstract; introduction paragraphs 2-9; mooring description; sections 3.1-3.2; discussion paragraphs 46-47; conclusion paragraphs 50-55
sources.evidence: French Guiana observations from 2003-10-06 to 2004-02-18: variable earlier flow, later northwestward flow; transition depends on site/depth. Non-detection of persistent flow at 22 m and below leaves upper-20-m flow possible; not basin-wide absence. Mooring distances, ring size and tracer boundaries are not current width.

Resolve source convention and layer, obtain upper-layer observations and distinguish shelf flow from offshore ring passage before any annual axis or width.
